# namespace_persistent_volume (Data Source)

Reads details of a Namespace persistent volume by ID or unique tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_persistent_volume" "runner_disk" {
  tag  = "runner-workspace-volume"
  site = "eu"
}

output "volume_id" {
  value = data.namespace_persistent_volume.runner_disk.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique persistent volume ID. Exactly one of `id` or `tag` must be specified.
- `site` (String) Optional site/region filter (e.g. 'zrh', 'ord', 'iad') to scope the volume query.
- `tag` (String) Unique persistent volume tag. Exactly one of `id` or `tag` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `attached_to` (String) Compute instance ID the volume is currently attached to, or null if detached.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `destroyed_at` (String) RFC3339 destruction timestamp, if destroyed.
- `released_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the volume was released/detached.
- `released_reason` (String) Reason why the volume was released.
- `size_mb` (Number) Volume size in megabytes.
